# TextElementBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Base class for text-based PDF elements that provides common functionality for font handling, text encoding, and line wrapping. This reduces code duplication across text elements and ensures consistent text rendering behavior.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`.

## Properties

- [`Color`](#color): TextBlock color for rendering
- [`CurrentPageToken`](#currentpagetoken): Token for injecting the current page number
- [`Decoration`](#decoration): Text decoration (underline, strikethrough, overline, or a combination)
- [`DecorationColor`](#decorationcolor): Colour of the decoration lines.
- [`DecorationStyle`](#decorationstyle): Line style for decorations (solid/wavy/dashed/dotted).
- [`DecorationThickness`](#decorationthickness): Thickness of the decoration lines in points.
- [`FontFamily`](#fontfamily): Font family name (e.g. "Helvetica", "Times", "Arial") for weight/italic resolution.
- [`FontFeatures`](#fontfeatures): OpenType feature overrides for embedded text, such as kern=0 or liga=0.
- [`FontName`](#fontname): The resolved PDF font name used for rendering.
- [`FontSize`](#fontsize): Font size for text rendering
- [`FontWeight`](#fontweight): Font weight (100-900).
- [`Italic`](#italic): Whether the text should be rendered in italic/oblique style.
- [`LetterSpacing`](#letterspacing): Letter spacing (tracking) in points, added after every glyph.
- [`LineHeight`](#lineheight): Multiplier applied to font size to compute line height.
- [`TotalPagesToken`](#totalpagestoken): Token for injecting total pages count
- [`WordSpacing`](#wordspacing): Word spacing in points, added after every space.

### `DecorationColor`

```csharp
Color? DecorationColor { get; set; }
```

Colour of the decoration lines. Null = use `Color`, the default.

### `DecorationStyle`

```csharp
DecorationStyle DecorationStyle { get; set; }
```

Line style for decorations (solid/wavy/dashed/dotted). Default solid.

### `DecorationThickness`

```csharp
float? DecorationThickness { get; set; }
```

Thickness of the decoration lines in points. Null = the default derived from font size (`max(0.5, fontSize / 18)`).

### `FontFamily`

```csharp
string FontFamily { get; set; }
```

Font family name (e.g. "Helvetica", "Times", "Arial") for weight/italic resolution. When set, FontName is automatically resolved via FontFamilyResolver using the current FontWeight and Italic values.

### `FontFeatures`

```csharp
IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> FontFeatures { get; set; }
```

OpenType feature overrides for embedded text, such as kern=0 or liga=0.

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`.

### `FontName`

```csharp
string FontName { get; set; }
```

The resolved PDF font name used for rendering. Can be set directly (e.g. "Helvetica-Bold") for backward compatibility, or resolved automatically from FontFamily + FontWeight + Italic. Setting this directly clears FontFamily.

### `FontSize`

```csharp
float FontSize { get; set; }
```

Font size for text rendering

### `FontWeight`

```csharp
FontWeight FontWeight { get; set; }
```

Font weight (100-900). Normal = 400, Bold = 700. When FontFamily is set, triggers automatic resolution. When FontFamily is not set, uses the current FontName as the base family for resolution.

### `Italic`

```csharp
bool Italic { get; set; }
```

Whether the text should be rendered in italic/oblique style. When FontFamily is set, triggers automatic resolution. When FontFamily is not set, uses the current FontName as the base family for resolution.

### `LetterSpacing`

```csharp
float LetterSpacing { get; set; }
```

Letter spacing (tracking) in points, added after every glyph. Default 0. Reflected in measurement and both PDF and SVG output.

### `LineHeight`

```csharp
float LineHeight { get; set; }
```

Multiplier applied to font size to compute line height. Default is 1.2. Set to a value like 1.5 for looser leading or 1.0 for tight leading.

### `TotalPagesToken`

### `WordSpacing`
